verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents WebAuthn (security keys and device biometrics) as an MFA factor and explicitly supports passwordless login via one-time codes delivered by email or SMS, positioning these as first-class login options alongside password/social. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of magic links (link-based, not just code-based) as a distinct passwordless method, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of passkey/WebAuthn sign-in UX quality.
